extension.description: Hosts the Letterboxd and Premiumize Downloader add-ons and pushes their updates automatically.

extension.summary: Browse your Letterboxd account in Kodi
extension.description: Browse your Letterboxd watchlist, diary, and custom lists directly inside Kodi. Works with just a username (via RSS) or with an official API key for richer data and private lists.
extension.disclaimer: A Letterboxd account is required. API credentials are optional but enable private list access and password-based login.

extension.summary: Download your premiumize.me cloud files at full speed and play them locally
extension.description: Browse your premiumize.me cloud, download videos over several parallel connections, start watching while they download, and play them from local or USB storage. Downloads resume after restarts, and subtitles next to a video come along with it.
extension.disclaimer: Needs a premiumize.me account. Not made by or affiliated with premiumize.me.
extension.news: 1.0.3: When no USB drive is visible, explains that a drive set up as "device storage" must be formatted as removable storage. 1.0.2: "Choose download folder..." now lists USB drives found directly on the device (Kodi's own folder browser often misses them on the Shield), shows free space and size, and accepts a typed path. 1.0.1: Selecting a cloud video now shows the Play now / Download only / Stream choice as a normal list before playback starts (it could be invisible before). Corrected the Shield permission path in messages. 1.0.0: first release
